minor.issue: The HTML served at `/` by Expo's web dev server does NOT include the PWA tags from app/+html.tsx (<link rel='manifest'>, <meta name='apple-mobile-web-app-capable'>, <meta name='theme-color'>). +html.tsx is only applied by expo-router's STATIC rendering output; current app.json has `web.output = 'single'` (SPA), so in the preview/dev build the base template is served instead. In a production export this would include the tags, but on the live preview URL the PWA head tags are currently missing (verified via Playwright DOM: manifest=false, themeColor=null, appleCapable=null). manifest.json and sw.js themselves are reachable.

integration_issues.issue: Browser cannot discover the manifest because `<link rel='manifest'>` is absent from the dev-served `/` HTML (see backend minor issue). Fix suggestion: switch `web.output` to `static` in app.json so +html.tsx is used, OR change expo-router dev index to a plain `web/index.html` that already contains the manifest/theme-color/apple-mobile-web-app-capable tags and the SW register script.

action_items: HIGH: PWA head tags missing on the live /. app/+html.tsx is correctly written but Expo only runs it for `web.output: 'static'` (currently 'single' in app.json). Either (a) switch app.json → web.output='static' and re-export so +html.tsx is applied, or (b) inject the three required tags (<link rel='manifest' href='/manifest.json'>, <meta name='theme-color' content='#2B2B2E'>, <meta name='apple-mobile-web-app-capable' content='yes'>) into the dev template / public/index.html so they are present on the dev server too. All other PWA pieces (manifest.json served, sw.js served, icon files, SW register script) are in place.

rca_of_issue: PWA head-tag gap: Expo Router's app/+html.tsx is a STATIC-rendering hook. app.json currently sets web.output='single' (SPA), which uses the default web/index.html shell during both dev and export. That default shell does not carry a <link rel='manifest'>, so when the preview URL serves the SPA shell, the browser never discovers the manifest and PWA install cannot be triggered through standard browser UI (even though manifest.json and sw.js are both served correctly). Mitigation A: set web.output='static' in app.json and expo export → +html.tsx shell is written to disk and includes all PWA tags. Mitigation B: author a `web/index.html` (or metro `publicPath` HTML) with the three required tags and the service-worker register snippet, so the dev shell also carries them. Mitigation A is preferred because +html.tsx is already correct.
